messages:
Maria Nguyen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — running list for runbook/playbook edits. The recurring cache-eviction pattern that caused the spike needs triage commands + clearer escalation. Assigning owners? ETA by EOD Mon? :white_check_mark:

Sam Patel: Happy to own runbook edits. I'll add triage steps and example commands. ETA Wed COB.

Alex Chen: I can take the escalation path rewrite + ensure paging thresholds align with SLOs. Will sync with Pager on Monday.

Tess SRE: Can you include the exact commands we used in the incident? I pasted them below. Also request a test plan.

OpsBot: Incident 2026-03-22T03:12:45Z summary: KV cache thrash -> worker spinups -> evictions -> latency spike. See artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/incidents/2026-03-22/cache-thrash

Sam Patel: Commands from incident:
```
# check eviction metrics
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=kv-cache -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring exec -it prometheus -- curl -s 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=cache_evictions_total'
# force cache dump and restart
kubectl -n inference exec -it kv-cache-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'mv /data/cache /data/cache.bak && kill 1'
```

Jordan Riley: Add automated smoke that simulates TTL storm and verifies eviction backoff.

Maria Nguyen: Owners: Sam (runbook edits), Alex (escalation & paging thresholds), Jordan (test plan & smoke), Tess (validation). Timelines: Sam Wed COB, Alex Tue EOD, Jordan next Tue, Tess to validate within 48h of PR merge. @oncall please confirm no conflicts with dedicated runbooks.

Oncall Bot: @oncall Ack — no current changes to dedicated runbooks. Recommend canary publishing to staging first. :eyes:

Alex Chen: I'll also add a "when to roll back" bullet that references model routing fallback and how to switch to smaller batch sizes.

Sam Patel: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/1243 — includes triage steps, commands, and checklist. Please review.

Tess SRE: Reviewing now. Two suggestions: add `kubectl describe pod` step and include metric query for 'kv_cache_inflight' so SREs can tell before eviction.

Maria Nguyen: Great. Let's close action items in the postmortem doc. I'll add owners + due dates in the tracker. Reminder: label runbook PR with `postmortem-cache-thrash` so we can link back.

Jordan Riley: Will schedule a runbook tabletop on Thurs 09:30 PT.

Sam Patel: Done. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
